§6Yellowcake§f

§aYour uranium is sitting there doing nothing. Time to turn it into something useful.§f

Yellowcake is the first step in uranium enrichment. It's a fine yellow powder that emits mild radiation (0.5 RAD/s) but isn't pyrophoric, so you can handle it without dying. Barely.

§6How to Make It§f (Chemical Plant):
§b•§f §e500mB§f Hydrogen Peroxide
§b•§f §e2§f Uranium Billets
§b•§f §e2§f Sulfur
§b→§f §eYellowcake§f

§6What It's For§f, Uranium Hexafluoride (Chemical Plant):
§b•§f §e1,000mB§f Water + §eYellowcake§f + §e4§f Fluorite
§b→§f §e1,200mB§f Uranium Hexafluoride + §e2§f Sulfur

Both §bfluorite§f and §bsulfur§f loop back through the process. Fluorite comes out of the centrifuge, sulfur comes out of UF6 production. Once you start, you don't lose materials.

§ePS:§f Check JEI for the full recipe chain. Yellowcake can also be compacted into granular blocks for storage, though you'd need a lot of them.
